content: .{@-नः@} the path leading to मोक्ष; सत्येन पन्था विततो देवयानः <ls>Muṇḍ. 3. 1. 6</ls>.

देवनः [दीव्यत्यनेन दिव् करणे ल्युट्] A die. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Beauty, splendour, lustre. .²2 Gaming, gambling, a game at dice; प्रकाशमेतत्तास्कर्यं यद्देवनसमाह्वयौ <ls>Ms. 9. 222</ls>. .²3 Play, sport, pastime. .²4 A pleasure-ground, a garden. .²5 A lotus. .²6 Emulation, desire to excel. .²7 Affair, business. .²8 Praise. .²9 Going, motion. .²10 Grief, lamentation, sorrow. .{@-ना@} .²1 Gambling, a game at dice. .²2 Sport, pastime. .²3 Lamentation.
